review_information.notes: CraftSky Plus is a monthly auto-renewing subscription for the CraftSky account signed in when purchasing. It includes scheduled posts, saved folders, profile customisation, pinned posts and follower-growth statistics. Plus and Business are alternative subscription levels, with Business including Plus benefits. Purchases and restores remain linked to the original CraftSky account; switching accounts does not transfer access. Subscription management and Restore purchases are available from Settings > Subscriptions.

review_information.notes: CraftSky Business is a monthly auto-renewing subscription for the CraftSky account signed in when purchasing. It includes all Plus benefits, featured products, a profile action button, business details and events. Plus and Business are alternative subscription levels in one group. Purchases and restores remain linked to the original CraftSky account; switching accounts does not transfer access. Subscription management and Restore purchases are available from Settings > Subscriptions.
